title: Make VixenApp's MSVC /bigobj requirement declarative
body: The native Release VIXEN graph reached 715/1283 then MSVC C1128 failed on VIXEN/application/main/source/graph/BuildRenderGraph.cpp. I added /bigobj to the existing VixenApp MSVC target options so the native target can compile. Consolidate the native MSVC object-format compatibility policy in the shared preset/target configuration; tier:luna, effort:S because this is a scoped one-target build-contract fix with a native witness.
